rationale: Structural validity has priority over every economic or information classification.
A failed hard implementation, risk, accounting, or turnover gate is a valid-protocol failure.
Fewer than 500 valid paired sessions, missing finite return inputs, or no primary scheduled record prevents a directional conclusion.
Zero actual target-state changes or zero completed episodes limits mechanism information; no arbitrary event quota is substituted.
The two-sided HAC upper bound is strictly below -2 percentage points annualized.
The one-sided 95% HAC lower bound is strictly above zero and cumulative excess is strictly positive.
The two-sided upper bound is below zero but at or above the -2pp harm floor; it is statistically negative but not a hard economic harm breach.
The positive point estimate is uncertain because the two-sided interval includes zero.
The mean excess estimate is exactly zero; zero is not positive evidence.
The negative estimate is uncertain because the two-sided interval includes zero.
Every remaining finite valid return region is uncertain and cannot be chosen subjectively.
